SELECT
      phase_label,
      label,
      value
    FROM (
      SELECT
        multiIf(
          phase = 'pre_discussion', '1. Pre-discussion',
          phase = 'pre_vote', '2. Pre-vote',
          phase = 'voting', '3. Voting',
          phase = 'post_close', '4. Post-close',
          phase
        ) AS phase_label,
        'Median posts' AS label,
        toFloat64(median(posts)) AS value,
        multiIf(
          phase = 'pre_discussion', 1,
          phase = 'pre_vote', 2,
          phase = 'voting', 3,
          phase = 'post_close', 4,
          9
        ) AS seq
      FROM dbt.api_governance_discussion_phases
      WHERE is_gip = 1
      GROUP BY phase
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        multiIf(
          phase = 'pre_discussion', '1. Pre-discussion',
          phase = 'pre_vote', '2. Pre-vote',
          phase = 'voting', '3. Voting',
          phase = 'post_close', '4. Post-close',
          phase
        ) AS phase_label,
        'Median likes given' AS label,
        toFloat64(median(likes_given_in_phase)) AS value,
        multiIf(
          phase = 'pre_discussion', 1,
          phase = 'pre_vote', 2,
          phase = 'voting', 3,
          phase = 'post_close', 4,
          9
        ) AS seq
      FROM dbt.api_governance_discussion_phases
      WHERE is_gip = 1
      GROUP BY phase
    )
    ORDER BY seq, label
